mintAuthority.summary: USDsui is issued through Bridge's Open Issuance platform on Sui. The TreasuryCap was wrapped at deploy into Bridge's shared TokenAuthority contract (0xd4fc1ca0b...) via stablecoin_manager::register_stablecoin. Minting requires MinterRole, held by Bridge operational address 0xb1e7dc9a5... The TokenAuthority is shared (no single owner) with Bridge controlling AdminRole and MinterRole.

controls.label: Bridge TokenAuthority shared contract (TreasuryCap wrapper)
controls.evidence: Sui RPC: tx CRwtcn7FYUu7Sr7EzVToa1nbDRzVfmB1djFqJWyVJEjv called stablecoin_manager::register_stablecoin shortly after deploy, wrapping TreasuryCap 0x57eafc43... into a Stablecoin<RESERVE_LEDGER, USDSUI> struct (object 0x80954159...) stored in the TokenAuthority's tokens ObjectBag. TreasuryCap is non-transferable while wrapped; total_supply.value = 73,574,877,360,000 (73.57M USDsui at 6 decimals). TokenAuthority owner = Shared (initial_shared_version 741908290). Package 0x94e8cb8df... contains modules: reserve_ledger, token_authority, stablecoin_manager, minter, burner, blocklist, bridge_ecosystem_minter. Init bytecode constant string: 'USDsui is Sui's native, USD-backed stablecoin, issued via Bridge's Open Issuance platform'.

controls.label: Bridge MinterRole holder (0xb1e7dc9a...)
controls.evidence: Sui RPC suix_queryTransactionBlocks: MinterRole<RESERVE_LEDGER> and MinterRole<USDSUI> (plus MinterRole<stablecoin::STABLECOIN> and BurnerRole) all held by 0xb1e7dc9a51c2e86e45f6c930f411b8f22dbc2204c964d174e3666816f7ecaac3. This address calls minter.mint and minter.wrap regularly in active Sui transactions, confirmed operational Bridge minter. AdminRole held by 0xb7fec6160... (holds UpgradeCaps for stablecoin and reserve_ledger packages). BlocklistRole held separately by 0x50b9aa5bd...

controls.label: Bridge Sui mint-package UpgradeCap owner
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298463699, UpgradeCap 0x6b5accd5473c2f194c84a7ca6ac422729d9ef4d8c9f4275823a24f0295b1c8d1 was address-owned by 0xb7fec6160bbb02eed26e2ffd24c458e1a391c88cd47018e973ef82d2d7519423. Its fields identify Bridge mint package 0x94e8cb8df7796c7ea57f747f330ef61aedd8f48d48f7ac21bc975708a6ca6a1a, policy 0, version 1. That package implements minter, stablecoin_manager, and token_authority for the shared object holding USDsui's wrapped TreasuryCap. Recent transactions sent by the owner use Sui signature scheme byte 0x00 (Ed25519). The separate USDsui coin-package UpgradeCap is held by deployer 0xd76f7d309d52d1020e50588997bb5b82d25e870542316fa082a6c6cdf93e3290, but the coin package only initializes the coin and does not hold the wrapped TreasuryCap or implement the active mint path.

review.evidence: Sui RPC: TreasuryCap 0x57eafc43... traced to wrapping tx CRwtcn7F... which called Bridge's stablecoin_manager::register_stablecoin; TreasuryCap is locked in Stablecoin<RESERVE_LEDGER, USDSUI> wrapper (obj 0x80954159...) inside TokenAuthority shared object 0xd4fc1ca0b... MinterRole confirmed at 0xb1e7dc9a5... (active operational Bridge minter). At checkpoint 298463699, Bridge mint-package UpgradeCap 0x6b5accd5... for package 0x94e8cb8d... had policy 0, version 1, and was address-owned by 0xb7fec616.... Sui's upgrade documentation confirms a retained UpgradeCap can authorize compatible package upgrades that change function implementations. The separate USDsui coin-package UpgradeCap controls only the coin initialization package, not the active wrapped-TreasuryCap mint path.. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: Bridge's operational EOA can mint without a firm cap, while no USDsui-specific recurring reserve reconciliation or product-level prudential authorization or independent attestation is evidenced. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: Bridge publishes real-time transparency and quarterly attestations for other issuance products, but Bridge and Sui materials plus targeted searches expose no USDsui-specific reserve balances, report, or endpoint reconciling the complete USDsui supply. Codex reconciliation wave 1 research: Bridge's public USDsui transparency feed, updated 2026-08-14, reports total_onchain_amount 74,015,081.75, total_reserve_amount 74,015,081.75, cash and Treasury reserve components, and collateralization_ratio 1.0; Bridge therefore continuously reconciles USDsui supply against its published reserves.
